latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Marketing Metrics Dashboard skill.

- Provides a step-by-step process for setting up and tracking 7 essential small business marketing metrics: Leads, Conversion Rate, Average Transaction Value (ATV), Break-Even Point, Gross Margin, Churn Rate, and Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), plus Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
- Guides users to build or update a KPI dashboard, including data gathering, estimation methods, and context-sensitive prompts.
- Includes health status assessment for each metric to prioritize action.
- Supports both measurement (filling current numbers) and planning (setting targets) sessions.
- Explains compounding profit leverage from small improvements in multiple metrics.
- Covers the CAC vs Profit-Per-Sale decision rule to evaluate marketing campaign profitability.
